title: Outside gas shut-off.
officialText:
Existing gas services shall be provided with an outside emergency shutoff device
acceptable to the commissioner and the fire commissioner in accordance with the retroactive requirements of item 1 of
section E6 of appendix E of the New York city fuel gas code. Installation of such a device shall be completed no later
than January 1, 2010.
Exception: For R-3 occupancies, the installation of such a device shall be completed no later than January 1, 2020.
